I'm not sure if I've gone too extreme, but I have a lot of ideas to help voat deal with shills, bots, brigades, and the like without censorship. I already posted my first idea (twice) to v/AskVoat and v/ideasforvoat so I'll just start with the second idea here. I also asked where I could find out how Voat currently works so I could avoid posting ideas that voat already uses, but I didn't get much help there.

  1. Allow moderators to see who upvoats and downvoats on their subs - so they can identify bots and brigaders easily
  2. Kind of like voter ID, each sub should have a CCP requirement, separate from your overall CCP, only taking into account upvoats and downvoats within that sub. Users who meet the requirements should be able to call mods into question, and if necessary, replace the mod by popular vote. - This is to guard against shills and SJW's taking over subs, and also to get rid of inactive mods.
  3. Before mods can make any significant changes to the sub (like raising or lowering the CCP requirements, or adding/removing rules) they should have to call it to a vote - so the subs eligible voters get a say.
  4. A roof on how high a subs CCP requirements can be, determined by the admins. - So it can't be impossibly high.
  5. I noticed this sub has a guide posted on how to spot logical fallacies, a similar guide should be posted on voats homepage to help our users spot obvious propaganda (left or right wing)
  6. Just like the guide on how to spot propaganda, a guide on how to construct a good argument should be posted, because right now it seems like a lot of name calling is being done, and very few actual discussions are being had.
  7. Similar to the option allowing users to display which subverses they're subscribed to, there should be a mandatory list displaying which subverses you're banned from. (only visible to mods, it's to help them determine if an account is a likely bot)

  8. Begging for upvoats should be against Voat rules. It's the quickest way for shills and SJW's to become unrestricted accounts, and nobody should get an express pass to join the community.

  9. Delete inactive accounts. Lots of times, redditors will make their way to voat, decide it's boring and head back, only to wind up back on Voat during the next big scandal, this time with year old accounts that may have enough CCP to be unrestricted. By deleting inactive accounts we can prevent that, and also we'd only potentially lose fake internet points and maybe a cool username.

I'd consider these changes to be like tougher immigration laws rather than censorship, I'd like your support on v/ideasforvoat, or a reason why this is too extreme/SJW's can take advantage of it. Also check out my first idea because they're all really supposed to work together.
